cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/classic_labels.py" -o $D/classic_labels.py
chown tbot:tbot $D/classic_labels.py; cd $D
for tf in 15m 5m; do timeout 50 sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_labels.py $tf 2>&1 | grep -v "пример паттерна" | cut -c1-330; done
